title: The greatest day of your life
header_line: My analysis of one book on habits. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Why is today the greatest day of your life?

I asked a student: why is this the greatest day of your life? The student answered: for the opportunity to continually improve and work at something I am passionate about. Another said: it is the discipline of living in the moment, not getting stuck in anticipation.

A student said the book talks a lot about dopamine hits. I said: super normal stimuli, heightened versions of reality. If you are constantly in a heightened version of reality, people see you at a higher energy, driven by that stimulus.
I said that the book ends with: after the habit I need, I will think and act as the person I want to be; after the habit I need, I will do the habit that I want.
I asked: would a successful writer be screwing off during the day and not sit down for two hours? You have to chip away.
A student said: say I am a person who exercises regularly. When you feel tired in the morning, say it, and it starts to permeate your decisions and reinforce itself when you start getting results.
A student said: your actions will display how much you actually want something. If your behavior does not show it, then what do you actually want?

I said that as a leader, if people are pumped when you are around and flat after you leave the room, you are not being a good leader. You are a good leader when it is transformative and they stay pumped up after you leave. I added that it is key to pick the right people.
What would make today the greatest day of your life, and will your actions show it?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write why today could be the greatest day of your life.
Write the character you play today.
Write your sentence: I am a person who...
Write what your actions would show you want.
Write what stays after you leave the room.

check.q: What did I ask the group to say about today?
choices: Why it is the greatest day of your life

check.q: What did a student say your actions display?
choices: How much you actually want something

check.q: What did I say a good leader leaves behind?

recap: Make today your greatest day. Say who you are. Let actions show it.
